# AFRICA EYEWEAR — Shinsegae Centum City (Busan, Korea)

> Optician and sunglasses store on B2 (basement level 2) of Shinsegae Centum City department store, 35 Centum nam-daero, Haeundae-gu, Busan, Korea. Tel +82-51-745-2574. Tax refund for foreign visitors.

## Key facts (confirmed 2026-10-16)
- Hours: Mon–Thu 10:30–20:00; Fri–Sun and public holidays 10:30–20:30
- Closed on Shinsegae Centum City closing days (2026: 2026-10-19, 2026-11-09)
- Location: directly below Exit 10 of Centum City Station (Busan Metro Line 2), facing the B2 central plaza between the department store and the mall. Same complex as Spa Land.
- Single-vision prescription glasses ready in about 30 minutes
- Free eye test by licensed opticians, no appointment needed
- Tax refund for foreign visitors: instant refund at the counter or tax-refund receipt; passport required
- Payment: Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; prices in KRW (please ask in store)
- Languages: English; other languages via translation app
- Brands: Oakley, Ray-Ban, Miu Miu, Moscot, 999.9, Kamemannen, Masunaga, Eyevan 7285, Markus T, Lash, Laurence Paul, Public Beacon, plus house brands
- Korean name: 아프리카안경 신세계백화점 센텀시티점
